title: Tabbi Party catalog (catalog.v1)
description: backend/shared/catalog.json: the values the Party server accepts in profiles and presence, and its limits. The Worker imports it, GET /v1/catalog serves it, and clients bundle it so pickers offer only valid values (docs/study/backend-api.md). A newer catalog may add fields; clients ignore the ones they don't read.

version.description: The catalog's revision. A client whose copy is older can fetch GET /v1/catalog.

breeds.description: The breeds of each species, keyed by a species id. A profile's breed must belong to its species; the first is the default.

heartbeatSeconds.description: Recommended seconds between heartbeats, keyed by status. A user stays online until 2.5 intervals pass without one; offline has no interval, since it ends presence at once.

partyIdleExpirySeconds.description: A party with no activity for this long ends.
